channel.title: Fetch Puppy
channel.description: Most recent updates to Fetch Puppy

item.description:
What's New

  • An example file name under the naming options shows how your files will be named, on the Spotify, Apple Music and CSV pages and in Settings
  • Download engine updated for the latest YouTube changes

Fixes

  • The Downloads list no longer jumps back to the current track each time a download finishes
  • After Spotify sign-in, Fetch Puppy closes the browser it opened and leaves a browser you already had open alone
  • A Facebook video that needs a login now says so in its row
  • A social media download that failed with no title now shows its link

Known Issues

  • Some Instagram, Facebook and Vimeo videos only download while you are logged in to them in the browser Fetch Puppy uses, shown in Settings

What's New

  • New option to name files Title - Artist instead of Artist - Title, in Settings and on the Spotify, Apple Music and CSV pages
  • Download engine updated for the latest YouTube changes
  • A failed social media download now says why in its row

Fixes

  • In numbered playlists and albums, a track with no artist no longer gets "Untitled" in its file name
  • TikTok videos that failed to download while a browser on this Mac held TikTok cookies download again
  • Public Reddit videos that failed to download now download
  • Public Vimeo links that asked for a login now download
  • A download that failed before its title loaded now shows its link instead of "Queued"

Known Issues

  • Some Instagram and Vimeo videos only download while you are logged in to them in the browser Fetch Puppy uses, shown in Settings

What's New

  • Faster YouTube audio downloads
  • YouTube playlist songs land one by one as they finish, and Cancel keeps the finished ones
  • CSV track lists can include a Duration column for tracks over 10 minutes
  • Downloads that only loosely match the track are tagged "Closest match"
  • Number tracks is now on the YouTube tab and also numbers video playlists and albums

Fixes

  • WAV downloads from Apple Music and Spotify no longer come out empty
  • AIFF files keep their artist, album, track number and cover
  • FLAC files are now true 16-bit
  • AAC audio from social media no longer carries a video track
  • Video downloads from Spotify, Apple Music and CSV get the music video, not an audio upload
  • Stopping a download while it converts no longer leaves a cut-short file
  • Downloading a playlist or album again keeps each old file until its new copy is complete, and leaves other formats alone
  • Retry re-downloads the exact video for YouTube playlists and Search
  • Songs are matched more reliably, including titles with apostrophes or in non-Latin scripts, and more often to their album version
  • Songs that YouTube's search hides behind an age check are found again
  • When a match can't be downloaded, the next best match is used instead of failing
  • Search shows a full, steady list of videos, with more of them on screen
  • Spotify share links (spotify.link) now work
  • Channel and profile links are refused instead of downloading a whole feed

Known Issues

  • None known

What's New

  • Drag several Apple Music songs in together and they download as one batch
  • Dropping several links on the menu bar icon works the same as dropping them on the window
  • Apple Music session and live versions are tagged "Closest match" when only a different recording can be found
  • Search marks live streams, which can't be previewed
  • Quitting while downloads are running now asks first
  • Refreshed look across the window, sidebar and buttons

Fixes

  • Apple Music links load faster and more reliably
  • Search previews load in a few seconds again, and stay loaded when you reopen one
  • Downloads retry automatically when YouTube blocks the connection
  • Facebook and Vimeo videos saved as MP4 now play in QuickTime and QLab
  • Long video conversions are no longer cut off partway through
  • A stopped or failed video conversion no longer leaves a broken file in your folder
  • Clearer messages for Apple Music links that can't be downloaded: library playlists, personal mixes and music videos
  • Threads is no longer listed; Snapchat support is Spotlight videos only
  • Dropping a Facebook link from Firefox no longer warns about multiple links
  • The Fetch button and format pills stay put as you switch modes, and the window can no longer be sized too narrow for them
  • The downloads puppy runs the full width again, with a proper trot in both directions
  • Download engine updated

Known Issues

  • None known

• Filtering improvements; Spotify and Apple Music now fetch the album version of a track, not the music video. Stops tracks arriving with a video intro or a silent tail on the end. Sped up, slowed and pitch shifted uploads are no longer picked
  • Number tracks in playlists/albums is now on the Spotify, Apple Music and CSV tabs, not just in Settings
  • A single track no longer arrives with 01 on the front of its name
  • Tracks matched to a different recording are tagged "Closest match" and show their real length
  • Clearer wording while a track is being found, and when a download comes back incomplete

• Downloads from YouTube, Spotify and Apple Music work again after recent site changes
  • The download engine now downloads minor updates in the background
  • Searches match the right recording more reliably

• TikTok downloads are far more reliable, retries are handled automatically
  • Cancelling a download no longer removes it if you click twice (delay on remove button being active)
  • Other minor fixes

• Search results and video names appear much faster
  • Better drag and drop: thumbnails work, and a video dragged from a playlist skips the playlist question
  • Downloads tab shows progress and results more clearly, including a progress ring in the sidebar
  • Download engine updated
  • Cancelled downloads show as Cancelled, not Failed
  • Failed downloads are reported correctly and can be retried

• More reliable YouTube downloads. Apple Music links now work reliably
  • Optional "use one format for every service" setting: pick Audio or Video and a format once and it applies to every tab (off by default; each mode keeps its own setting otherwise)
  • Search results you have previewed stay highlighted, with the most recent one marked, so you can find your way back
  • The preview window Download button now shows the format you will get (MP3, MP4 and so on)
  • On the Search tab, right-click a Download button (in the list or the preview) to grab that result in a one-off format without changing your saved choice
  • On the Search tab, downloading a result keeps you on Search and marks it Added, so you can line up several without leaving the page
  • Queued playlists get ready in the background while they wait, so they start the moment their turn comes

• Rebuilt search preview/Added download button: streams load in the background as results appear, open faster, and play reliably
  • Now works on Intel Macs as well as Apple Silico
  • Each download row shows its actual format (MP3, AAC, MP4 and so on)
  • Drag several links at once to download them together, with faster track matching for Spotify, Apple Music and CSV
  • YouTube playlists now list every track, filling in as they load
  • Reddit and other social links that need browser cookies now download
  • Elapsed timer stops when a download finishes
  • MP3 downloads are now true 320 kbps CBR (were variable bitrate)
  • YouTube playlists can be cancelled mid-download, and a failed playlist can be retried
